title: Petra and the Postcard
author: Ivo Sterling
blurb: Orsen Pemberton, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
